fields.label: Email
fields.description: The list's address, e.g. news@acme.com. Mail sent to it is delivered to every enabled recipient. Its domain must be a Mail Domain of the site. Cannot change after saving.

fields.label: Domain
fields.description: Mail Domain the address belongs to. Derived from the email.

fields.label: Site
fields.description: Suite site that owns the list. Derived from the domain; the site's mailing list limit applies.

fields.label: Cluster
fields.description: Cluster the list lives on. Derived from the site.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: What the list is for, e.g. Product news. Shown on the cluster as the list's name.

fields.label: Stalwart ID
fields.description: Id of the list on the cluster. Set when it is created there.

fields.label: Aliases
fields.description: Other addresses that reach the list. Each must be unique across the cluster and under one of the site's domains.
